fusions.name: Web Spit
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of silk ahead of you, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it and stunning each for 1.2 seconds, with a 40% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Silk Barrage
fusions.desc: Hurls a silk bundle that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets and 80% as much to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Trapline
fusions.desc: Conjures a web onto the nearest enemy. It waits 1 minute, and the first 3 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 18 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Anchor Line
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next 2 spells deal 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
